learned: A 109-visit day came with no daytime posts and no tagged links, so the source is unknown.
Three trials started in one day, 2 of them Pro, again with no source tag.
Engagement-only days reach about 35 on X and 3 to 4 on Facebook.
suggestions: Check why no videos were sent on 7 Nov (the Buffer queue showed nothing between the 23:30 post on 6 Nov and 18:00 on 7 Nov); keep two videos a day on YouTube and Facebook.
Add tagged Whop links to captions and bios so spikes like 7 Nov can be traced to a channel.
Follow up with the three new trialists once Max approves a welcome or trial message (needs a send path).
